returns-standard.title: Standard Returns
returns-standard.body: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days. Opened electronics can be returned within 14 days when accessories and packaging are included.

returns-laptop-exception.title: Laptop Return Exception
returns-laptop-exception.body: Opened laptops are eligible for refund only within 14 days. After 14 days, support should offer warranty repair options instead of promising a refund.

holiday-extension.title: Holiday Extension
holiday-extension.body: Purchases made between November 1 and December 24 can be returned until January 31. This extension excludes activated subscriptions and final-sale clearance.

final-sale.title: Final Sale
final-sale.body: Final-sale clearance items cannot be returned unless the item arrived defective.

shipping-basic.title: Shipping Basics
shipping-basic.body: Standard shipping takes 5 to 7 business days. Weekends do not count as business days.

shipping-expedited.title: Expedited Shipping
shipping-expedited.body: Expedited shipping usually takes 2 business days, but weather and carrier disruption can delay delivery.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.body: Electronics include a one-year limited warranty for manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is excluded unless the customer bought protection.

price-match.title: Price Match
price-match.body: A price match can be requested within 7 days when the lower price is from an approved retailer and the item is identical and in stock.

marketing-laptop-sale.title: Spring Laptop Sale
marketing-laptop-sale.body: Laptop bags and accessories are discounted this spring. This marketing page does not change return eligibility.
